# Code review: PR #568

## Blocking

1. `src/stream.ts:88` — chunk boundary can split a UTF-8 codepoint; the decoder drops the partial bytes. Reproduce: send a 3-byte emoji split across two SSE frames. Fix: buffer trailing bytes until a complete codepoint arrives.

## Non-blocking

2. `render.ts:41` — table alignment assumes monospace; fine for now.
3. Missing test for the empty-chunk case.

Verified finding 1 with a local repro script; the other two are read-only observations.
